description.short: Search your repositories, code, issues, and pull requests.
description.full: This tool set enables an LLM to read and search information on GitHub, covering repositories, branches, commits, files, users, issues, pull requests and code navigation. To sign up, visit https://github.com/. Available in Microsoft 365 Copilot. To sign up, visit https://githubcopilot.com.
